Name: (AT) Kamichama Karin Clock Tower for Silo
Author: Luozhu0901
Description:
This mod uses the [b]Alternative Textures[/b] framework to replace the default silo appearance with a clock tower from [i]Kamichama Karin[/i]. It’s a purely cosmetic change and does not affect the functionality of the silo. You can change the appearance in-game by purchasing a Paint Bucket from Robin.
At the moment, there are two texture versions included: a regular one and a frozen version intended for winter. However, I haven’t been able to make a seasonal auto-switching version because I don’t have a winter save currently. For now, I recommend manually switching the texture using the Paint Bucket when seasons change.

本MOD通过[b]Alternative Textures[/b]模组，将原版筒仓（silo）的外观替换为《小女神花铃》中的钟楼造型。它不会影响筒仓的功能，仅是外观上的变化。你可以在游戏中从罗宾处购买油漆桶（Paint Bucket）来更换建筑外观。
目前我提供了两个外观版本：一个是常规形态，另一个是结冰状态的冬季版本。但由于我手头还没有冬季的存档，因此没有测试季节自动切换的效果。如果你想在冬季显示结冰版本，可以在换季时手动使用油漆桶进行切换。
